scientific_integrity: The infinite statement is supported by explicit collision estimates and the published marked Poisson approximation theorem; finite exact-enumeration checks are supplementary. Static extreme-run laws and finite bivariate generating functions are credited.
scientific_limitations: Only fair independent bits; per-site independent refresh; integer run lengths necessitate subsequences in the nondegenerate rare-run window.
A one-step two-copy theorem, not temporal path convergence or biased/Markov input.
Historical priority against a more general correlated-pattern theorem is not independently settled.
title: A sharp shared-run Poisson transition under independent bit refresh
